newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman upgrades Myriad.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman upgrades Myriad.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Matthew Murray upgraded Myriad Genetics Inc to buy from outperform.
-- The company and the University of Texas M. D. Anderson Cancer Center said on Wednesday they identified the first major gene responsible for glioma, a form of brain cancer.

-- "The gene discovery is important to Myriad because it is not covered under any (of) its existing corporate collaborations and is likely to be amenable to drug discovery," Lehman said in a summary report.
-- Lehman has a 12-month $51 target on the stock.
-- The stock was up three at 36-1/4.
